messages:
Ari (UX): Hey team — I sketched a quick iteration for the first-run welcome/banner and sample project strip. Fig: https://www.figma.com/file/xxxxxx/onboard-banners (updated frame "compact-inline-cta")
Noah (PM): Thanks Ari. High level: what are the changes compared to the current banner?
Ari (UX): Two main tweaks: 1) move primary CTA from the floating bottom-right to an inline sticker right under the sample project cards; 2) add a small keyboard hint ("Press / to start") and a subtle microcopy change to call out speed. Also trimmed default sample projects to 3 recommended + 2 optional, reordered by "fastest to run".
Jules (Eng): Inline CTA makes layout simpler for narrow viewports, but we'll need to ensure the banner doesn't push down the main content too much. Might have to clamp height and use overflow-x for cards.
Kim (Accessibility): A few immediate nits: don't auto-focus the banner on page load — that can be disorienting for screen reader users. The keyboard hint must be in the accessibility tree (not aria-hidden). Also ensure the dismiss button is at least 44x44 and has an accessible name.
Ari (UX): Good catches. I added an aria-live="polite" status region for the quickstart completion message and moved the hint into a button with visually-hidden text for SRs. Not focusing on load anymore.
Jules (Eng): Small CSS snippet I tried locally to keep the banner compact: `
.banner { max-height: 84px; overflow: hidden; display: grid; grid-auto-flow: column; gap: 12px; }
.banner .cta { align-self: center; }
`
Jules (Eng): Also, the gradient background on the banner reduces contrast for white text at low widths — will measure exact AA numbers tomorrow.
Noah (PM): Copy tweak suggestion: change "Try a sample project" -> "Try a sample project — runs in seconds" (short, benefit-focused). Thoughts?
Kim (Accessibility): That copy is fine as long as it's explicit. Also make sure the keyboard hint is visible and announced for keyboard users; adding `aria-describedby` to the input that opens quickstart could help.
Ari (UX): I'll update figma copy and add a note for `aria-describedby`. Will also increase button target and add a visible focus ring.
console-bot: deploy preview created for the banner branch: https://preview.internal/changes/9834 :white_check_mark:
Jules (Eng): Deployed preview looks good on Chrome, quick smoke passed. Fixed the earlier focus trap where keyboard users couldn't escape the cards.
Ari (UX): Thanks everyone — I'll post the updated figma link and the accessibility checklist after Kim signs off. :thumbsup:
